svg.title: docker bouncer: a crossover bounce
svg.desc: bounce_method: crossover · bounce_overprovision_factor: 0.33 · replicas: 3 1. v1 serves all traffic. 2. app-4 (v2) starts. 3. app-4 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy). 4. app-4 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic. 5. app-1 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish. 6. app-1 stopped and removed. 7. app-5 (v2) starts. 8. app-5 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy). 9. app-5 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic. 10. app-2 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish. 11. app-2 stopped and removed. 12. app-6 (v2) starts. 13. app-6 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy). 14. app-6 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic. 15. app-3 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish. 16. app-3 stopped and removed. 17. v2 serves all traffic. Bounce done.
svg.text: 3 · app-4 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy)
4 · app-4 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic
5 · app-1 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish
8 · app-5 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy)
9 · app-5 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic
10 · app-2 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish
13 · app-6 added to Envoy's list (no traffic until healthy)
14 · app-6 healthy → Envoy sends it traffic
15 · app-3 leaves the list; in-flight requests finish
17 · v2 serves all traffic. Bounce done.
crossover: a new replica joins before an old one leaves; capacity never drops
clients never reconnect: they talk to the proxy, only the proxy's upstream list changes
